sections.label: The difference
sections.heading: What's the difference between wallpaper and a wallpaper mural?
sections.intro: Wallpaper is a pattern that repeats. A wallpaper mural is one picture, made for one wall. That changes everything about how it's designed, printed and hung.
paragraphs: Chosen from a catalogue, bought by the roll.
One image, printed to your wall's exact size.

rows.label: Design
rows.text: A repeating pattern someone else drew. The same roll is on walls all over the country.

rows.label: Joins
rows.text: Narrow rolls, so a wide wall means many joins and matching the repeat at every one.

rows.label: Fit
rows.text: Cut to the wall after the fact. Whatever lands at the corners, lands there.

rows.label: Your brand
rows.text: Your logo, your colours and your city are not an option.

rows.label: Design
rows.text: One artwork for one wall: your logo, your colours, a photo, an illustration or a map of your city.

rows.label: Joins
rows.text: Panels up to 125 cm wide, printed to your measurements. An 8 metre wall has a handful of joins and the picture runs straight through them.

rows.label: Fit
rows.text: Designed to the wall before it prints, with 10 cm of bleed, so the focal point sits where you want it.

rows.label: Your brand
rows.text: Built around your logo and brand colours, checked by a person at full size, then installed by the team that printed it.

sections.label: How Mister Wallpaper does it
sections.heading: One team from the artwork check to the last trim, which is why the finish holds up
paragraphs: Every commercial job is treated as its own brief. Here's what that means on your site.

Your artwork, checked by a person before it prints Logo, brand colours, campaign imagery or a photo you supply. Every file is checked for resolution at full wall size before it goes to print. If there's any doubt, you hear about it first. Promised.
Printed to the wall, not to a roll Each mural is printed to your wall's measurements on PRO wallpaper panels up to 125 cm wide, so an 8 metre reception wall has a handful of joins, not a dozen.

Commercial-grade, PVC-free material PRO wallpaper is wet-strength, fade-resistant and recyclable, with a satin finish that's easy to maintain in a busy office, clinic or hotel corridor. It removes with water when the fit-out changes, with no damage to the wall.

Installed by our team or our installer network Sydney, Wollongong, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, with installation support in many other locations. Print turnaround is 5 to 7 business days, with a 3 day express option when the handover date is fixed.

sections.label: Before you send the wall
sections.heading: Everything a fit-out team asks before they send the wall
paragraphs: Both. Mister Wallpaper installs commercial wallpaper in Sydney, Wollongong, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, and has installation support in many other locations. If your builder or a site trade is hanging it, supply only is fine and the panels ship with the installation guide.

PRO wallpaper for most offices, hospitality, retail and healthcare walls. It's PVC-free, wet-strength and fade-resistant, printed on panels up to 125 cm wide with fewer joins, and it removes with water when the space changes. Commercial projects typically use durable vinyl or matte finishes that clean easily. For short-term displays and events, self-adhesive Peel & Stick panels can be repositioned and removed. The right one depends on the room and the wall condition, and that's part of the quote.

Send what you have. You can supply your own high-resolution file, or choose an image from a gallery of over 90 million stock photos and have it printed with your logo and colours. Every file is checked for resolution at full size before it prints, and you approve a layout proof first.

Custom wallpaper is printed and despatched within 5 to 7 business days of approval. Express 3 day printing is available for an extra charge when the handover date is fixed. Install dates are booked around your site program.

It's quoted per project, because the size of the wall, the material and whether we install all change the number. Fill in the form with the rough wall size and location and you'll have a quote within one business day. Prices include GST.

Murals are printed in vertical panels up to 125 cm wide to any wall length, so an 8 metre wall is 7 panels, not 15. Each panel prints with a 30 mm overlap for trimming on site, and the whole print carries 10 cm of bleed so an uneven ceiling or skirting never shows.
